column1: # Every place the compiled DuckDB code reaches mbedtls, written by check-duckdb-mbedtls.py --update.
# Categories, with why gkg-server never runs them:
#   extension-signature   SHA-256 and RSA checks on extension load; the lockdown blocks every load
#   extension-repository  SHA-256 fingerprint of a repository key; same lockdown
#   database-encryption   AES-GCM for encrypted databases; the server runs only constant setup SQL and generated SELECTs
#   temp-file-encryption  AES-GCM for temporary files; temp_file_encryption is off and locked
#   sql-hash              md5(), md5_number(), sha1(), sha256(); generated SQL never calls them
#   s3-sigv4              SigV4 signing; only httpfs calls it, and httpfs is not compiled in
#   force-setting         force_mbedtls_unsafe; the locked configuration rejects it
#   crypto-accessor       the accessors and interfaces the uses above go through
#   enum-names            enum to string conversion, no crypto
#   unused-md5-context    MD5Context hex helper with no callers
#   httplib-tls-off       httplib mbedtls TLS code behind CPPHTTPLIB_MBEDTLS_SUPPORT, which nothing defines
